DRAFT BILL — NARRATIVE FORM

Issued on behalf of APRIL FAR EAST (M) SDN BHD for 4 containers of 40'HC type.
Delivery is to TANGIER PAPETERIE SARL, with notification to CASABLANCA PAPETERIE SARL. The vessel
receives the cargo at PASIR GUDANG, MALAYSIA and releases it at CASABLANCA, MOROCCO. Laden mass
88,120 kg.
